level1.title: Little Girl, Get Up!
level1.story: Jairus begged Jesus to help his sick daughter. A sick woman touched Jesus' cloak and was healed. Then Jesus said to the girl, "Little girl, arise!" and she got up.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did Jesus say to the girl?
level1.prayer: Jesus, I believe in You. Amen.

activity.title: How did they feel?
activity.intro: Draw each face: worried before, joyful after!

level2.title: Jairus' Daughter and the Woman
level2.story: Jairus, a ruler of the synagogue, fell at Jesus' feet and begged Him to heal his little daughter. On the way, a woman who had been sick for twelve years touched His garment and was healed. Jesus said, "Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole." Then people came saying Jairus' daughter was dead, but Jesus said, "Fear not, only believe." Taking the girl's hand, He said, "Talitha cumi," which means, "Damsel, arise," and she got up and walked.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How did both people show faith?
Why did Jesus stop for the woman?
level2.prayer: Jesus, I reach out to You in faith. Amen.
